label: Add unread period fields to poster extractions read before period fields existed
summary: Insert start_date, end_date, session_count rows (value NULL, needs_check true, value_source ai) for extractions that already have field rows

execute.description: insert missing period field rows as unread (needs check)
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO public.poster_extraction_fields (extraction_id, field_key, value, confidence, needs_check, value_source, updated_at)
                  SELECT e.extraction_id, k.field_key, NULL, NULL, true, 'ai', now()
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT extraction_id FROM public.poster_extraction_fields) e
                  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('start_date'), ('end_date'), ('session_count')) AS k(field_key)
                  ON CONFLICT (extraction_id, field_key) DO NOTHING

postcheck.description: verify every extraction with field rows has all three period rows
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT extraction_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE field_key IN ('start_date', 'end_date', 'session_count')) AS n FROM public.poster_extraction_fields GROUP BY extraction_id) c WHERE c.n <> 3)
